title: Public Sector Tech Hub
description: An open directory of what UK public bodies make, run and deploy that others can adopt: an app store harvested weekly from publiccode.yml files, with licence, code, live service and sourced facts for every listing, and no ratings or reviews.
notes: Personal project, not an official government service, policy or endorsement. Code is MIT licensed; content and data are CC BY 4.0. Status at release: Prototype.
